description: This file defines functions and types for handling iMessage targets, including parsing, normalization, and permission checks within a messaging extension.

methods.name: normalizeIMessageHandle
methods.description: Normalizes raw iMessage handle strings by trimming, lowercasing, and standardizing prefixes.

methods.name: parseIMessageTarget
methods.description: Parses a raw string into an IMessageTarget object, identifying chat IDs, GUIDs, identifiers, or handles.

methods.name: looksLikeIMessageExplicitTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be an explicit iMessage target identifier based on prefixes.

methods.name: inferIMessageTargetChatType
methods.description: Infers whether the target is a direct or group chat based on parsing.

methods.name: parseIMessageAllowTarget
methods.description: Parses a string into an IMessageAllowTarget, handling service prefixes and normalization.

methods.name: isAllowedIMessageSender
methods.description: Determines if a sender is allowed based on configured criteria.

methods.name: formatIMessageChatTarget
methods.description: Formats a chat ID into a standardized string representation.
